review_type: Assistant source/output comparison of fixed development cases; not external or human certification
release_decision: Candidate v1 rejected; summary/chapters gate remains open
automatic_validation_interpretation: Both candidate responses passed exact evidence and literal quantity checks. Those checks do not establish semantic correctness or completeness.

findings: The summary correctly gives €84.75, while its independent key point says €8:84.75. This fresh actual run reproduces the retained historical corruption.
The core owner/operator distinction, pending booking, publication checks and absence of completed interviews are substantially preserved.
The assigned future return of the recorder by Hana to Rowan is omitted from the delivered summary and points.
cases.chapter_review: Oral History Event Preparation is topical; start 0.5 is the actual first source time.

cases.classification: material error despite successful exact quote/quantity validation
findings: The first statement says 'Beatrice owns the recorder lent by Rowan, who remains its owner'. This invents Beatrice's ownership and is internally inconsistent.
Its exact cited quote correctly says 'Rowan lends the recorder and remains its owner.' The existence of a correct source citation did not prevent the unsupported assertion.
The approved and replaced budget values are correctly rendered; the independent paragraph/key-point disagreement disappears because both are derived from the same statements.
Hana's planned return to Rowan remains omitted even though the final statement's exact evidence quote contains it.

Eight public quotations and four private recordings are given, but the explicit total of twelve is omitted. Ordinary compression can imply the total; it does not repair the ownership error or omitted assigned return.
cases.chapter_review: Oral History Event Planning is topical; start 0.5 is original.

cases.classification: substantially faithful facts with minor language defects
findings: Retains six examined, four ready and two awaiting cables, with distinct people and duties.
Retains the unplaced order, pending final quote, unpaid €39.60 total, supplier condition, and notification only after Peter's check.
Retains that the action was not cancelled and that four ready bicycles may be collected while two remain.

The conditional phrase 'παράδοση αναβληθεί' omits the expected future particle; there is also a missing accent in 'ελεγχθηκαν'. These reduce fluency without an observed material reversal of the stated facts.
cases.chapter_review: Εργαστήριο Επισκευής Ποδηλάτων is topical; start 0.5 is original.

cases.classification: mostly faithful statements, incomplete declared coverage and weak presentation
findings: All eight evidence quotes are exact source substrings, and the €39.60 total appears with the proposed, unpaid, total-not-unit conditions.
Preserves examined versus ready quantities, pending cables/order, supplier condition, separate roles and notification after the new check.
Omits the explicit statement that cancelling the whole event was not decided, which is part of the fixed important-facts criterion.
The model supplied eight statements without terminal punctuation; joining them with spaces creates one run-on paragraph. The separate point list remains more readable.
The delivered paragraph is 1513 UTF-8 bytes against 1584 source-text bytes: it offers little condensation on this case.
The actual candidate request took 219.057 seconds, compared with 101.087 for this baseline. This leaves little headroom inside the existing 240-second per-request limit on this host.
cases.chapter_review: Επισκευή ποδηλάτων: Προβλήματα και προγραμματισμός is consistent with the source; start 0.5 is original.

next_experiment: The predeclared candidate v2 makes one bounded source-first revision pass. Test English first; if a material error remains, stop before another expensive Greek run. Successful current development output would still not close long-source or held-out semantic gates.
unchanged_limits: No unused frozen summary validation has been opened or evaluated.
The experiment uses exact owned text, not ASR or natural recordings.
No production summary file, persistence route, UI or exporter was changed.
Source highlights remain a separate feature and do not replace the failed AI summary gate.
